searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he simplification rules the awtsmoos is one; the user facing motion should therefore feel like one river, not many competing mechanisms. auto scroll has two visible states: start and stop. no countdown in the ordinary ui. no automatic pause merely because a menu, lens, dialog, touch, wheel, or reading key appears; the user can stop when desired. pace remains adjustable, but only one clear speed control is primary. unit, preset, eye line, density, and estimate machinery may remain internally compatible but must not crowd the default mobile surface. reader appearance options belong behind a single expandable appearance section. main menu should prioritize navigation labels, not long explanations. ikar should identify itself as a torah library with hebrew/english identity and meaningful section names; internal readiness language should not be prominent ui. no new !important; rewrite active owners rather than escalate specificity. next action apply these rules to autoscrollbutton/controller/session/wiring, lens semantic controls/markup, menu renderer/styles, and ikar fallback/first light css.

searchText: b"h — 01 — runtime contract map every repair below must honor these contracts. a contract change is allowed only if every consumer is traced first (source law). data identity contract (db → api → semantic model → renderer → ui) db record for ikar: id, name, title, author, createdat. there is no description field — never assume one, never render a placeholder that pretends to be data. absence gets an elegant quiet state, not fabrication. api: get /api/social/heichelos/ikar → the record; get /api/social/heichelos/ikar/series → series list (the written torah, the oral torah). client builds a semantic model (normalized; must include semantic) and the renderer paints ui from it. pipeline is one way; ui never invents fields. presentation never hard codes "the entire torah" — it renders the title from the payload. same for every series/post title, count, and timestamp. boot chain contract (phase 0) order: critical boot.js → ikar stable.js → ikar first.js. bootikarfirst must be a callable function exported through this chain. the current breakage is exactly this export contract being violated. first light contract: semantic must exist in the document before the first paint that reads it; heichel boot title and the discovery list hydrate from the semantic model, never from literals. auto scroll contract (reader) start = immediate continuous motion. no countdown, no ramp up ceremony. stop = stop and stay stopped. no phantom restarts, no drift. measure the real scroll vessel (the element that actually scrolls in a real post), never a window proxy or a guessed container. interval measurement must be proven in a real post vessel, in a real browser. css contracts social styles live only under .awtsmoos social root. leaks are defects. every stylesheet gets classified: active / compatibility / dormant / legacy / dead. no !important wars — specificity conflicts get resolved by scoping, never by escalation. whole site chrome (heichelos focus, breadth track) renders from shared design tokens (see 05). navigation contract (gating check) global top nav is persistent and offers one tap home from every route. mobile: safe area insets respected, touch targets ≥ 44px. failing the one tap home check on any route fails the whole track. motion contract transform/opacity only for animation; 60fps budget. every animation ships a reduced motion counterpart (stillness, not a lesser animation). timid/washed out default = defect. shared motion language everywhere: staggered card entrances, tactile press feedback, route continuity (forward pushes in, back returns gracefully). server contract node index on port 8080. no watcher → restart after every change before verifying. no build script; npm run test: are the suites (headless node). regression tests for auto scroll do not exist yet — they must be new files. release contract the dirty shared worktree (dd77276a2) never deploys. release = clean isolated worktree from fresh origin/main, exact file set, gates pass, commit, fast forward push only. then npm run bh (node scripts/bhrelease.mjs — read it first) on the remote ssh host, then verify public production in a real browser (public sha verification).
